starsSource: Gaia DR3 (ESA archive), G < 19, positions at J2016.0 with proper motions
notes: Pixels: SPHEREx L2 IMAGE minus the pipeline ZODI model, bilinearly resampled (TAN-SIP WCS) onto a common north-up grid at 6.15″/px.
Masked or off-detector pixels are replaced by the frame median; FLAGS are not applied.
Frames chosen on detector D2 so the wavelength at the target is within half a resolution element of 1.336 µm where possible; see epochs[].matched.
Known objects: found with JPL sb_ident (first pass, observer = SPHEREx spacecraft position) at each frame time, then positioned with JPL Horizons (geocentric) at every frame time.
Stars: Gaia DR3 sources with G < 19 (ESA archive); those moving faster than 1″/yr are listed in known[] with their position at every frame time.
Flags: the SPHEREx L2 FLAGS plane resampled onto the grid (bitwise OR of the source pixels); see flagBits for the bit names, and epochs[].flagged for the fraction of pixels with a hard or soft flag.
